description: A node_retire that removes a node: the Spawner archives it with trigger_reason operator_removal (architecture §3.13.8). The common fields are in data.schema.json.

node_id.description: The node, by its platform identity: the identifier node_review and node_query name it with (architecture §3.12.3).

operator_proof.description: The operator's proof of the act, with act node_retire (implementation §9.2).
